note: City campground in Riverside Park on the Rum River in downtown Princeton; canoe launch, fishing pier, swimming area and playground in the park, off-leash dog park across the river. Sites 1 and 8 are nearest the beach and playground; 3, 4 and 7 have the most shade. --Claude
summary: City page, park map and the city's RoverPass booking page read: 8 back-in W/E sites 34-60 ft (30/50 A), 3 tent pads, showers, no dump; 10-night limit; season May 1 - Oct 18; RV $35 in 2027 ($30 on the 2026 page). Not waterfront confirmed. Note cleaned.
flags: FEES: the city page still shows the 2026 rate ($30 with electricity, $25 without; the $25 sites are the tent pads); the RoverPass engine sells 2027 RV nights at $35. Written as $35 (2027) with the 2026 figure in the note.

WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed: on Esri imagery and the city map the RV loop (centre ~45.5724,-93.5788) sits ~55-70 m west of the Rum River, with the park trail and a continuous bank tree line between. The city calls sites 1 and 8 'adjacent to the beach and the playground' (the swim beach is day use at the north end), not on the river.

BOOKING: the city's reserve button links a claimed RoverPass listing (isBookable true), so RoverPass is the booking channel; consider adding https://www.roverpass.com/c/riverside-park-princeton-mn/ as a second website line.
